request.description:
Parameters Required \ Optional Type Value
Message required string SMS message that needs to be sent.
Phone required string The recipient phone number.
Sender required string The ID that will be displayed in the recipient's phone as the sender.
The "Sender" field is restricted to a maximum of 11 characters (Consecutive characters, no spaces) or a Phone number that contains maximum 14 digits (no characters)that allowed in the white list in the system(to insert the phone to the white list go to the folder Whitelist - Sender ). You can also write an asterisk (*) at the beginning
of the identifier.

Parameters
Required\Optional
type
Value
TemplateId
required
int

The template Id in the sysytem.

TemplateParameters
Name
required
string
The name of the parameter in the template.
Type
required
string

The "type" parameter determines the source from which the dynamic information for the message will arrive.

"contact" - means that the information will come from the contact in the system.

"custom" - means that the information will come from a field that you passed inside the recipient object (the field name is exactly the field name you passed in the recipient object).

"text" - means that the parameter will be replaced by a fixed text (does not change per recipient).
Value
required
string
The field name (for contact/custom type) or the fixed text for "text" type.
Recipients
Phone
required
string
The contact Phone Number
firstname
optional
string
The contact First Name
lastname
optional
string
The contact Last Name
CouponCode
optinal
string

The value of the custom field.

You can create multiple custom fields.

The get template list function return all the template in inforuMobile system by the user.
The returned list incloude the next fields:

TemplateId - the id of the template in the system

TemplateName - the name of the template in the system

MessageText - the content text in the massage

TemplateParameters - the name of the parmater in the massage

ApprovalStatus - Approval Status number

ApprovalStatusDescription- approved, waiting to approval ,not approved, not send(Temporary status)

Optional Approval Statuses

Approval Status Approval Status Description
0 Not sent
1 Approved
2 Waiting for Approval
3 Not Approved
4 Disabled
5 New
6 Unsubmitted
7 Paused
10 Pending Deletion

request.description:
You need to use this function if you want to control the email structure via API only and set the body and subject of the email without using a predefined template on the user interface.

Parameter
Required\Optional
type
Value
CampaignName
Required
string
The campaign name that you want to the newsletter
CampaignRefId
Optional
string
The campaign unique ID.
If you want to aggregate data in the system reports on the same campaign number, send the same CampaignRefId.
If you do not send this parameter, the system will use default value and aggregate all the mails of that month in one campaign. (if it sent from same sender)
FromAddress
Required
string
The mail address that you send from this address have to be in white list in the system
Subject
Required
string
The email subject
Body
Required
string
The email content
IncludeContacts
Email
Required
string
The email of the contact

This function creates or updates contacts.
You can send up to 5000 items per request. (If you send up to 10 items, the response is final,
if you send more, for final response use "Check Status Token" function).
The key for update is Email address, or Phone number, or both.
Email or Phone is mandatory all other fields are optional.

Parameters

Key
Required\Optional
type
Value
FirstName
Optional
string
The first name of the contact
LastName
Optional
string
The last name of the contact
PhoneNumber
Required
string
The phone number of the contact
Email
Required
string
The email of the contact
ContactRefId
Optional
string
The Contact's unique ID in the calling system.
FirebaseToken
Optional
string
Use for sending notifications to Google devices and apple.
If you send only FirebaseToken without Email or Phone, you should also send ContactRefId.
Platform
Optional
string
"ANDROID" / "IOS", If you use FirebaseToken you should also send Platform"ANDROID" / "IOS", If you use FirebaseToken you should also send Platform
Device1StatusId
Optional
int
Use for sending notifications to Google devices and apple.
The parameter can set with an active or inactive contact token
1 = active
-3 = inactive
GenderId
Optional
int
1=Male , 2 = Female
AddToGroupName
Optional
string
Add to group by name, if the group does not exist it will be created automatically
RemoveFromGroupName
Optional
string
Remove from group by name
RegistrationCampaign
Optional
string
Allows you to record where the contact came from.
You can enter a value in the field only when creating a new contact
EmailSubscriberStatus
Optional
Subscribed / Unsubscribed
Allows you to choose whether the contact's Email is added in a subscribed or unsubscribed state (default is subscribed)
\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\*contact our support for configuration at support@inforu.co.il
PhoneSubscriberStatus
Optional
Subscribed / Unsubscribed
Allows you to choose whether the contact's phone number is added in a subscribed or unsubscribed state
(default is subscribed)
\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\*contact our support for configuration at support@inforu.co.il

Note: To delete an existing means of contact (email or phone) you need to write "delete" in value.
**\\\\\\\\* If you wish to use EmailSubscriberStatus or PhoneSubscriberStatus - please contact supprot@inforu.co.il to configure before use. without configuration, existing status of a contact on your contacts list will remain the same regardless of what you pass in the parameters.

QuotaUsageType Optional string choose type to get the quota for specific product (SMS\Email\IVR).
If the field is empty the result will return all the Quota types
Level Optional string choose level under your account to get quota to this level (Partner/Customer/Project/User). If the field is empty the result will be by customer level
LevelValue Optional string Enter the value of the level that you chose
